title: After update to Android 16, G7 does not stay connected
body:
### Subject of the issue
Link to the discussion thread:  #4425 
Connection to the sensor regularly drops out, sometimes temporarily fixed by removing and reentering the pairing code

### Your environment
- Version: March 6 2026 nightly
- data source: G7 through dex
- Phone: Motorola g stylus 2025 running android 16 (WIVAS36.62-22-16-1)
- settings match those in the [troubleshooting guide](https://navid200.github.io/xDrip/docs/Intermittent.html)

### Expected behavior
Readings every 5 minutes 
### Actual behavior
Connection to the sensor cuts off randomly but often, frequent errors on the system status page (shown in #4425)

### Steps to reproduce the behavior:
recommended settings on moto stylus 2025 android 16 with g7 sensor

### Screenshots
#4425

comments.body: I think its going to be phone specific or is a bug fixed in later firmware versions. So we will need to reproduce with a phone that is having this problem. Pixel for example does not have this issue.

Have you tried to deactivate/disable 'Bluetooth-A2DP-Hardware-Offload' in the Android dev-settings?
I experienced the same behavior with my Moto G75 and disabling changed several connection issues with Headsets too. 
I am currently using the clumsy but stable workaround via Juggluco broadcasting as Libre piped to xDrip with "libre (patched)" broadcasting to openAPS. Since openAPS doesnt accept the Juggluco data as filtered, it blocks SMB. Via xDrip its enabled.

> Have you tried to deactivate/disable 'Bluetooth-A2DP-Hardware-Offload' in the Android dev-settings? 

I've just tried it, and it unfortunately does not seem to have fixed the periodic disconnection.. thanks for the idea though I'll check if any of the other dev bluetooth settings do something, I didn't go through all of them before.

Hi!

As GH promptly linked (above), I believe, I am affected by this sort of issue as well.

Are there any other hints to try out and see if there are better results?

Thank you!

☀️

Thank you for this. I got it working with 640G/EverSense. Nice to have a workaround until it gets sorted.
